title: EventsPage
description: Page of events returned when reading a run log from a cursor. Reading from the last cursor returns an empty events list and the same cursor; that rule is enforced by the reference model, not by this schema.

state.description: State of the run at the moment of the read.

events.description: Events after the requested cursor, in cursor order.

items.description: One event of the run log.

next_cursor.description: Cursor to pass to continue reading. Equals the requested cursor when there are no new events.

last_cursor.description: Cursor of the last event that exists in the run log, 0 when the log is empty.
